summary: Frontend-only iteration 40 testing for clickable score-breakdown drawer on /analysis/{ticker}. All 9 acceptance criteria verified end-to-end against the live preview using NFLX (rf_disagreement_penalty=12, prob_down=0.80) plus AAPL/TSLA/GOOGL for the no-calibration regression state.
verified_acceptance_criteria: PASS: data-testid='score-breakdown-toggle' renders ONLY when confidence_score_pre_calibration !== confidence_score. Verified absent on AAPL/TSLA/GOOGL (pre==post) and present on NFLX (78→66).
PASS: Button is interactive — cursor=pointer, disabled=false; aria-expanded toggles 'false'→'true'→'false'; chevron toggles ▸→▾→▸; aria-controls='score-breakdown-drawer'.
PASS: Click reveals data-testid='score-breakdown-drawer' inline; second click hides it (toggle, not modal). DOM reflects this exactly.

PASS: NFLX hybrid drawer text contains: 'Claude said BUY', '20% up', '80% down', 'strong' (edge), '12 points'. Probability bar with data-testid='score-breakdown-prob-bar' rendered. Source link with data-testid='score-breakdown-source-link' has href='/technical#random-forest'.
PASS: Drawer text contains the academic citation 'Krauss, Do & Huck (2017)'.

PASS: Re-analyze does NOT auto-close the drawer mid-flight. Drawer remained present in the DOM at +800ms / +3000ms / +6000ms after clicking Re-analyze (button text='Thinking…'). Stepper mounted concurrently with drawer still open.

PASS regression: data-testid='score-breakdown' wrapper present, data-testid='score-breakdown-final' shows '66 final' for NFLX, AnalysisProgressStepper mounts during analyzing (Fetching data → Technicals → Patterns → LLM verdict → RF score → Calibrating phases visible).

PASS regression: data-testid='confidence-calibration-breadcrumbs' renders both states correctly — 'Confidence calibrations applied' on NFLX (with adjustment list bullet '· RF model disagrees (strong edge, 80% down) — confidence reduced by 12 points (was 78, now 66).') and 'Verdict Accuracy v2 · no calibration needed' empty-state on AAPL.
SKIPPED: Backend pytest regression — per agent_to_agent_context_note, no backend changes this iter; iter39 was clean (17/17).

test_evidence.NFLX_drawer_text: Claude said BUY. The Random-Forest secondary model — trained on 346 US stocks since 2021 — gave it 20% up / 80% down over a 20-day forward window. Direction disagrees with Claude on a strong edge — so we lower the displayed confidence by 12 points rather than override the verdict. Top features driving RF: rsi_14=40.76, realized_vol_20d=0.45, spy_ret_20d=0.11. Penalty rule grounded in Krauss, Do & Huck (2017)…
test_evidence.no_cal_state_text: VERDICT ACCURACY V2 · NO CALIBRATION NEEDED — Earnings-proximity gate and RF-disagreement penalty both ran clean — confidence shown is Claude's raw output.
test_evidence.drawer_persistence_during_reanalyze: Drawer remained in DOM at +800ms, +3000ms, +6000ms while run-button text was 'Thinking…'

critical_code_review_comments: AnalysisReportPage.jsx is now ~1300+ lines and violates the >700 line guideline. Recommend splitting the score-breakdown drawer into its own component (e.g., components/ScoreBreakdownDrawer.jsx) — it has self-contained state and would reduce parent re-render cost. Not blocking.

The drawer renders P(up)=0% / P(down)=100% as fallback when rf_opinion.prob_up/prob_down are undefined (line ~681,685 default `?? 0` and `?? 1`). For the rf_disagreement_penalty branch this is fine because the branch only runs when rf_opinion truthy, but worth verifying the prob values are always present whenever rf_disagreement_penalty>0 to avoid a misleading '0% up / 100% down' bar.
Inline onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave style mutation (line ~618-619) re-allocates style on every hover. Minor — could be a CSS :hover rule. Cosmetic.
fadeIn keyframe in index.css is global. Consider scoping to avoid potential collision with future animations of the same name.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing NFLX/AAPL/TSLA/GOOGL verdicts already on the admin account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 40 added a clickable score-breakdown drawer. All UI testids: score-breakdown-toggle, score-breakdown-drawer, score-breakdown-prob-bar, score-breakdown-source-link. Drawer has two narrative branches (rf_disagreement_penalty vs earnings_gate_applied). NFLX is the canonical demo with rf_disagreement_penalty=12, rf_opinion.prob_down=0.80. Use API /api/analysis/{ticker}/latest with admin token to inspect calibration fields. AAPL/MSFT/TSLA/GOOGL all currently have pre==post (no calibration needed) so the toggle correctly stays hidden there. NVDA/META/AMZN have pre=null (older verdicts pre-iter39) so score-breakdown also hidden — expected.
